nodes.notes: Runs before any source and before any metered call. Sourcing is free, enrichment is not, and an upload that 403s after enrichment has already been paid for is money gone.

nodes.name: Product Hunt: recent launches
nodes.notes: v2 GraphQL. v1 was deprecated in 2023; v2 is the live one. Get a developer token from your app's page on api.producthunt.com. There is a query complexity limit of 1000 — that is why topics is capped at 2 and makers/comments are not requested at all.

nodes.name: Hacker News: Show HN
nodes.notes: Algolia's HN index. No auth, no key, no rate limit worth worrying about — the cheapest source here, and the earliest: a Show HN post predates a G2 listing by a long way.

nodes.name: LinkFinder: decision maker
nodes.notes: n8n's retry does not catch this endpoint's real failure: it answers HTTP 200 with a fake person whose name is a status message. The next node is what detects that.
